The Kubernetes state shows the deployment is trying to pull an image tagged "agentscope-missing" which cannot be found (NotFound error), causing ImagePullBackOff failures. While 2/3 pods are currently running (likely from the previous version), the rollout is progressing and failing due to this bad image reference. The service selector and ports are correctly configured, ruling out service configuration issues. | Hypotheses: productcatalogservice has a bad image rollout - the deployment is configured with an image "us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/google-samples/microservices-demo/productcatalogservice:agentscope-missing" that doesn't exist, causing new pods to fail with ImagePullBackOff while old pods are still serving traffic. vs There could be additional application-level issues in the running pods beyond just the image pull failures, requiring more than just a rollout undo. | Support: Kubernetes events show "Failed to pull image" with "agentscope-missing" tag, "NotFound" errors, "ErrImagePull" and "ImagePullBackOff" failures.
